description: WP-12C pinned inventory of LLM/provider egress sites. Keyed by unique call-site identity '<relpath>::<qualified-scope>::<kind>#<ordinal>'. The alias-resolving scanner (assurance/egress_scan.py) must find exactly this set: no new uninventoried site, no stale entry. 'location' is advisory (line:col at pinning time); the identity key is line-independent so refactors don't churn the pin. Classes: 'runtime' = a live request-path provider call (guard_status tracks whether PRIV-001b has routed it; the ENFORCING 'every runtime site is guarded' assertion lands with PRIV-001b, PR #328, not here); 'allowlist' = an operational/one-shot script, runtime-adjacent, with an owner-acknowledged follow-up; 'fixture-only' = an offline benchmark/eval harness that calls a provider ONLY on fixture/eval corpora, never production or user data, and is not imported by any production module (proven per entry). No broad directory allowlist is used — every site is enumerated individually. Editing this file changes a security bar; it is a protected surface.
